POLARITY -- evidence differs by bit, stated precisely rather than applied uniformly: for BIT1-BIT5, the official PDF (p.11) states the value legend '1：正常 ; 0：缺失' (1=normal, 0=missing) DIRECTLY on each bit's own row, and the V2 workbook (rows 68-72) independently states '1 — справний/наявний, 0 — відсутній' (1=functional/present, 0=absent) on each -- two independent sources agree: 1=present/normal, 0=absent/missing.
